result.topic_en: A flyleaf with a bibliographic note on a German book from 1814, followed by a statement of Lagrange's inversion theorem expressing f(x) as a power series in u when x = t + u ψ(x).

Oswald der Greis oder mein letzter Glaube. Herausgegeben
von E.[?] F.[?] Dintreib[?]. Lpz. bei Gerh.[?] Fleischer d. J. 1814. 1 th.[?]
Elysion[?].

Lagranges Theorem
$x = t + u\psi x$
$fx = ft + u\, f't.\psi t + \frac{uu}{2}\,\frac{d\, f't.\psi t^2}{dt} + \frac{u^3}{2.3}\,\frac{dd.\, f't.\psi t^3}{dt^2} + \&c.$

methods.what: Lagrange inversion theorem: series expansion of f(x) in powers of u, where x is defined implicitly by x = t + u ψ(x)
